end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to plate.
Compared nearby spinach with apples grown farther away.
Connected greater distance with more fuel use and pollution.
Discussed refrigeration and plastic packaging as possible effects.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and comparing foods by travel distance, using nearby spinach and apples from farther away. They connected longer journeys with more petrol or diesel use, pollution, refrigeration, and packaging waste. The idea was still being formed, so at home, ask them to explain food miles using two foods in the kitchen and identify which travelled farther.
